The '''''Verdant Song''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Ananah Kragana]] and a group of Republic operatives traveled aboard the ''Verdant Song'' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] to [[Mezhra Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the world.
